name: CarPlay Keys
description: MAP, NAV, MEDIA and the steering wheel's MODE open the CarPlay screen, media key, NEMESIS Manager or the HMG-API app you pick for each, or stay the car's own (Off). Hold a button for the car's own press. Adds CarPlay Play/Pause, Next Track and Previous Track to the car's star (★) button choices. Set it up from the CarPlay Keys tile in the app menu. Three presses of NAV within 1.5 s each open NEMESIS Manager.
